job.description:
Consultant Forensic Psychiatrist – Canberra

Location: Canberra, Australian Capital Territory
Remuneration package: Up to $520,000
Relocation and professional expenses: Reimbursement of up to $55,000

Medipeople is seeking an experienced Consultant Forensic Psychiatrist to join a highly regarded public mental health service in Canberra.

This is an outstanding opportunity to take on a senior clinical role across a diverse forensic mental health service while enjoying an excellent remuneration package, generous leave entitlements and comprehensive relocation support.

Remuneration and benefits

The package includes:

  • Total remuneration of up to $520,000

  • Reimbursement of relocation, specialist college, medical registration and visa application expenses—up to $55,000

  • Psychiatry allowance of $75,000

  • 17.4% on-call allowance

  • 12.5% superannuation

  • Four weeks of professional development leave

  • Potential conjoint academic appointment with a leading Canberra university

The role

You will provide specialist psychiatric care across the full range of forensic mental health settings in the Australian Capital Territory, including:

  • The ACT’s adult all-gender correctional centre

  • A youth detention centre supporting young people aged 12–21

  • A secure forensic mental health unit with 25 high-security beds, comprising 10 acute and 15 subacute beds

  • Mental health court assessment and liaison services

  • Forensic consultation and intervention services

Working as a senior member of multidisciplinary teams, you will:

  • Provide high-quality, recovery-focused psychiatric assessment and treatment

  • Lead the development and implementation of individual recovery plans

  • Supervise and support psychiatry trainees and medical students

  • Work closely with correctional services, courts, GPs, community agencies and other stakeholders

  • Contribute to clinical governance, service development and quality-improvement initiatives

  • Participate in teaching, training and research activities

The service has established research and academic relationships with the Australian National University, the University of Canberra and Australian Catholic University. Suitable applicants may also be considered for a conjoint academic appointment.

About Canberra

Canberra offers the amenities and opportunities of a capital city without the congestion and housing costs typically associated with Sydney and Melbourne.

With a population of approximately 500,000, Canberra is a prosperous, multicultural and highly liveable city offering:

  • Excellent public and private schools

  • Six universities and strong academic and research opportunities

  • Extensive employment options for partners in healthcare, government, defence, technology, education and professional services

  • National cultural institutions, galleries, museums and major events

  • Outstanding facilities for community and professional sport

  • Extensive parks, nature reserves, cycling trails and outdoor recreation

  • Convenient domestic air connections

  • Easy access to Sydney—approximately three hours by road or one hour by air

Essential requirements

Applicants should have:

  • Fellowship of the Royal Australian and New Zealand College of Psychiatrists (FRANZCP) with advanced training in forensic psychiatry; or

  • International specialist qualifications and training that may be suitable for assessment through an applicable RANZCP specialist pathway

  • Substantial experience working within forensic psychiatry services

  • Strong clinical leadership and communication skills

  • Extensive experience working in multidisciplinary environments

  • A commitment to supervision, education and professional development

Internationally trained psychiatrists with suitable UK or comparable specialist training are encouraged to apply.

Support from Medipeople

Medipeople provides friendly, expert and personalised assistance throughout the entire recruitment and relocation process, including:

  • RANZCP specialist assessment

  • AHPRA medical registration

  • Visa and immigration applications

  • Employment documentation

  • Relocation planning

  • Ongoing support after your arrival in Australia

For a confidential discussion or further information, please contact the Medipeople Psychiatry Recruitment Team.

job.title: Psychiatrist - Chid and Youth
job.description:
This is a Permanent Full Time, Permanent Part Time, Permanent Sessional, Fixed Term Full Time, Fixed Term Part Time, Fixed Term Sessional and Casual appointments with the possibility of extension(s) and/ or permanency.

Are you a dedicated and passionate Child and Adolescent Psychiatrist/Senior Medical Practitioner seeking a fulfilling career opportunity? Look no further!

Exciting Opportunities for Consultant Child and Adolescent Psychiatrists in the Child and Adolescent Mental Health Service (CAMHS) in Perth across 3 areas:

  • Inpatient Unit (Ward 5A), Perth Children’s Hospital
  • The Eating Disorder Service
  • Community CAMHS

We currently have multiple permanent vacancies available across the following areas. Fixed Term appointments (with the possibility of extension/s) will also be considered:

  • 3 x 1.0 FTE - Perth Children's Hospital
  • 4 x 1.0 FTE - Community Child and Adolescent Clinics

About the Role: As a Consultant Child and Adolescent Psychiatrist, you will play a pivotal role in delivering diagnostic and consultative specialty services in Psychiatry. Your contributions will extend to teaching, research, quality improvement, and administrative activities within your service area. This is a unique chance to be part of a dynamic team, shaping the future of mental health care for children and adolescents.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide high-quality clinical management and treatment to patients of the service.
  • Uphold and elevate professional standards while fostering an academic environment that supports education, research, and professional development.
  • Actively contribute to teaching, research, and quality improvement initiatives.

What we are looking for:  The ideal candidate will be registered, or eligible for specialist registration, with the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA). Fellowship (or pending Fellowship) with the Royal Australian New Zealand College of Psychiatrists or equivalent as an overseas trained specialist who has completed their training in either the UK, Ireland, Canada, USA (ABPN certified) or New Zealand with 3 years Consultant/Specialist level work experience. Completion (or approaching completion) of the Certificate in Advanced Training in Child and Adolescent Psychiatry (RANZCP) or equivalent is highly desirable.

About the services:

Inpatient Unit (Ward 5A), Perth Children’s Hospital

The Inpatient Unit (Ward 5A) is the 20 bed tier-4 State-Wide Service offering inpatient mental health care for young people up to 16 years old. You will be supported by a full Multidisciplinary Team and Junior Doctors. Up to three (3) psychiatrists share responsibility for the patients.

The Eating Disorder Service

The EDS is the Tier 4 State-Wide Specialist Service, offering assessment and treatment to young people with severe eating disorders. It is a Multidisciplinary Team providing outpatient care, day treatment, inpatient care and support groups. The program supports children and young people and their families through assessment, recovery and discharge from the service. Our primary intervention is Family Based Treatment (FBT).

Community CAMHS

Community CAMHS has 10 services across the Metropolitan area. Community CAMHS see infants, children and adolescents with various mental illnesses resulting in significant impact upon their functioning. We would work with you to match you to a clinic that suits your circumstances.

Perks and Benefits:

  • Join a vibrant and collaborative team.
  • Access to ongoing professional development opportunities.
  • Contribute to ground-breaking research and advancements in mental health care.
  • Competitive remuneration and supportive work environment.
  • Generous relocation package

How to Apply: If you are ready to make a significant impact in the field of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, we invite you to apply. Submit your application showcasing your experience, qualifications, and enthusiasm for this role.

Don't miss this chance to be part of an organisation committed to making a difference in the lives of young individuals. Apply today!
